description: The plot illustrates the loss over iterations for three different configurations of SepLLM, alongside a constant reference line. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and uses a linear scale with a visible range from approximately 90000 to 130000, featuring numeric tick marks at intervals of 5000 from 95000 to 125000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and employs a linear scale ranging from 2.0 to 3.0, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.2. There are four lines depicted on the graph. The solid pink line without markers, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)", begins above the y-axis maximum of 3.0 prior to iteration 95000, declines sharply to approximately 2.4 by iteration 103000, and continues a gradual descent to end near 2.21 at the right edge of the plot. The solid dark blue line without markers, labeled "SepLLM (n=128)", also starts above 3.0 near iteration 95000, decreases steeply to cross 2.6 around iteration 100000, and steadily declines to finish just below 2.3 at the end of the x-axis. The solid orange line without markers, labeled "SepLLM (n=64)", follows a similar trajectory to the dark blue line but remains slightly higher; it starts above 3.0, features a sharp, brief upward spike to approximately 2.65 near iteration 100500, and concludes at roughly 2.3. All three solid lines are surrounded by a lighter, semi-transparent shaded region of their respective colors. Finally, a dashed red line without markers, which corresponds to a blank grey box in the legend, runs horizontally across the entire plot at a constant y-value of 2.35.
